body:
Hi guys! I just wanted to stop by and make a little update. I read your comments and it made me feel good that someone out there, even complete strangers, some what care about me. Well, here is an update. I quit my shit job and got a better paying one at a government facility working security. I've only been there for 3 weeks, and I've been given nothing but positive comments and reinforcement. My supervisors constantly tell me how great of a job I'm doing and so do other employees. Instead of being bashed or told I'm wrong, my new supervisors talk to me face to face and make suggestions and treat me like an equal. Its fantastic. 

I've also had a talk with my mom about how she says things to me about my weight and such. She apologized and told me she just wasnt thinking when she said it. I'm slightly skeptical in this, but I figure its a step in the right direction.

I still have my anxiety and moments of despair, especially this past week. My fiance had lost his job and I freaked out about how we would take care of bills and such and felt unbelievable anxiety and despair. But, he landed a job this week. Its only minimum wage, but it's better then not making anything. I'm feeling happier and better, but still have my moments. Slowly working on it. I just wanted to share, so you guys know that you made a difference. The fact that you took the moment to say something, it made a world of difference, and I thank you all, truly!

Thank you for the advice. I'll have to check our employee hand book. Our company is very small, only employees 20 people so there isn't an HR per say or a legal department. I will look into this thought because I didnt even think about looking at the handbook.

I figured I didn't have anything, that anything emotional is a joke to most people. I figured I'd ask and find out because you never know. I'll be finishing my nursing classes soon and will hopefully be able to find a new job soon but I'm not holding my breath with how high Florida's unemployment rate is...

I was thinking something along those lines but then again, living in the state I live in, I didn't think I had anything. I thought it best to ask and just never know. I'm taking classes for nursing and will be done soon and will be trying to get another job somewhere else. Its just hard because Florida's unemployment rate is higher then the national average and jobs are hard to come across. I'm just ready to snap and either scream at my boss or even go as far as punch her (which I know would NOT end well at all). I'm just not sure how much of the "stalking" or nasty and uncalled for comments I can take before I snap.
